glosses: 假装害羞的，故作忸怩的

examples.text: The ill-bred miss, the bird-brained Jill, / May simper and be coy at will; / A lady, sir, as you will find, / Keeps counsel, or she speaks her mind, / Means what she says and scorns to fence / And palter with feigned innocence.
Come sit thee down upon this flowery bed, / While I thy amiable cheeks do coy.
For now there are ſprung up a wiſer generation in this kind, who have the Art to coy the fonder ſort into their nets
